description: Annotate each Space at its centroid with Label · Area · L×B dimension, in m / cm / ft. Forwards the Space on.
instructions:
Writes a centred annotation block into each incoming Space — Label, Area and the bounding L × B dimension — in the chosen `unit` (m / cm / ft). The Space is forwarded unchanged downstream.

Toggle `showLabel` / `showArea` / `showDimension` to pick which lines appear; `label` is the optional first-line text.

TIP: chain it after room-generating nodes to tag each Space with its name + area for a schedule.
